transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I just don’t feel like doing anything anymore—not cooking, not music, not even playing dominoes with my friends. My daughter arranged for us to meet because she's been so worried about me ever since we moved to this new apartment.
How long have you been feeling this way, and did it start before or after the move to the new apartment?

It really started after we left our old house in Las Piedras and moved here, which was about a year and five months ago. Since that move, things just haven't settled back to how I used to be. It has been going on like this for most of the past year and a half.
Have you felt this low and uninterested for most days over the past year and a half, or did it come and go and improve at times?

It actually comes and goes. I have long stretches where I feel completely flat and tired with no spark at all, but then I'll have other times where I feel highly energetic, completely revved-up, and busy with all kinds of projects. Those active, high periods have actually kept coming back and lasted for a lot of this past year.
During those times when you feel highly energetic and revved up, do you also need much less sleep, feel unusually confident or talkative, or do risky or impulsive things?

Oh, absolutely, it's the strangest thing—I'll only sleep two or three hours a night but wake up completely wired, talking nonstop and joking too loudly. During those times, I feel so confident that I truly believe I'm a special messenger from God who could run the whole church, and I'll stay up rearranging closets at midnight or planning repairs for a building that isn't even mine.
Have you ever had a period of at least several days when you felt unusually high, energetic, or irritable and needed much less sleep, even when you were not depressed?

Yes, ever since we moved, I get these spells where I feel like a motor that won't turn off, sleeping only two or three hours but still feeling completely wired. On those days, I'll stay up rearranging the closets at midnight, but I can also suddenly snap and get very irritated with my family over tiny things.
How long do those high-energy, wired periods usually last at a time—at least 4 days, or do they continue for a week or more?

They definitely last for a week or even several weeks at a time. During those weeks, I feel like a motor that just won't turn off, sleeping very little and rushing from one project to another before I finally slow down.

final_diagnosis.reason: The interview confirms recurrent episodes of abnormally elevated/expansive mood with decreased need for sleep, pressured speech, increased goal-directed activity, irritability, grandiosity, and religious delusions, lasting at least a week to several weeks, alternating with depressive periods of low mood, anhedonia, and fatigue. This pattern is most consistent with bipolar affective disorder (manic episodes with depressive episodes).
